title: Recipe Page
prompt: Structure a recipe with a heading, ingredients list, numbered steps, and one image with a caption.
objective: Use semantic headings, both list types, and an image caption.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: headings, lists, images, sections.
hints: Ingredients are a group without sequence; cooking instructions are ordered.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
Simple Vegetable Pasta

Ingredients

  • 200 g pasta
  • 1 cup chopped vegetables
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions.
  2. Warm the oil in a pan and cook the vegetables until tender.
  3. Mix the pasta with the vegetables, season, and serve.
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: Ingredients are a group without sequence; cooking instructions are ordered. Required structural evidence: <h1>, <ul>, <ol>, <figure>.
